specificFindings: Often in the best-humanity/worst-conditions statement is retained; the philosophical framing is not converted into a guarantee every disaster improves every person or a causal experiment about happiness.

Comically and funny mark the authors amused treatment of Nietzsches self-praising essay titles. This tone is not a medical diagnosis,a proof of the titles claims,or evidence that others imposed the titles.

The question about many insights introduces Nietzsches attribution to illness. Attribution and retrospective self-interpretation are not rewritten as independently demonstrated universal effects of disease.

1869,age24,Basel,classical philology,and youngest appointed to that post remain paired. Philology is defined by the actual parenthesis as language history,not economics or physiology.1876 belongs to illness-forced leave,not the appointment.

Take leave does not establish permanent dismissal. The later recollection about lying still,leisure,waiting,and patience is treated with its context of illness and changed habits,not as advice to seek illness.

But that means,of thinking is a quoted continuation that reinterprets the earlier state. It is not a complete standalone clause or denial of the ability to think. The two immutable candidate IDs are separately addressed without renumbering.

Never happier with himself concerns retrospective self-satisfaction during the sickest and most painful periods. It does not mean pain disappeared,physical health improved,or every patient would report the same result.

Returning to his natural self is his reported feeling,not a physical move to a named town. Conversely and reverse perspectives mark bidirectional perspective shifts,not a modern medical prediction model.
Kahnemans2002economics Nobel is distinguished from1974paper and2022citation years. His influential1970s/1980s collaboration is with AmosTversky,not Nietzsche or a language-history chair.

The1974paper lists three heuristics; anchoring and adjustment forms the third combined name rather than two items that inflate the count to four. The citation count is inherited book history,not newly checked current bibliometrics.

Seven is the book-reported age for escaping occupiedParis,not the preceding death age90 or Nietzsches24. The recalled scary incident is approximately late1941or early1942; must have been is retrospective inference,not an exact verified date or command.

Turning the brown sweater inside out is distinguished from the soldiers black uniform. The empty-street encounter involves an approaching German soldier; later family internment material is not silently moved into this scene.

The black uniform is identified with specially recruitedSSsoldiers and recalled prior warnings. Looking intently is an observed action,not proof the soldier identified the hidden star or knew the childs name.

The soldier speaks German with emotion; exact words and specific motives are not supplied. Opening his own wallet,showing a boys photo,and giving money occur after he puts the child down. No claim is invented that the photographed boy was definitively his son.

The statement that people are complicated and interesting is Kahnemans recalled reinforcement of his mothers view. One encounter is not treated as evidence about the benevolence of every member of an organisation or the absence of persecution.

Interned inDrancy describes wartime detention,not professional internship. Supposed to be sent describes an intended transfer,not proof it occurred; the parent reports employer intervention and release separately.

The family route isVichy then centralFrance after German arrival. The father-death/afterwarPalestine continuation remains unassigned after this batch. Both final parent questions quote only their frozen target sentences so that continuation is not accidentally counted as direct evidence.
